text.offer: Hot day, eh? Sure would be a great day for a stunted dwarf. Ah, an ancient drink. Actually, the recipe has been lost in time, although I hear that Colhorr the blacksmith might know of it.
text.complete: How remarkable! You must be a persistent one. I must give you something equally rare in return.

steps.objective: Ask Colhorr about the stunted dwarf

steps.brief: Stunted dwarf? Ha! That's just a myth, and you tell Tova I said that!

steps.objective: Ask around Ko'catan about the stunted dwarf
steps.brief: Ah, well. If you ever hear anyone mention a stunted dwarf, you be sure to find out what you can. They say the islanders of Ko'catan still know their old drinks.
Ah, you need a recipe for your garden variety stunted dwarf, eh? Tell you what. Prove to me you're hero enough to drink one, and I'll give you the recipe. Go kill a kriipa for me.
Fine job. Take this recipe back to Tova.
